content:
As Tim Cook enters his final weeks as Apple CEO, John Ternus will take over on September 1.

In an interview with CBS News this week, Cook reflected on his 'legacy' as Apple CEO.

The interview took place in Houston this week, coinciding with the opening of Apple's brand-new advanced manufacturing center.

CBS News reporter Jo Ling Kent: "Looking back on your years as CEO, if you had to sum it up in one word, what would you say you represent?" Tim Cook: "You're asking about legacy, that's a good question. But in my view, your legacy is defined by others, not by yourself. So I hope others will say I was a kind and decent person. If in the end that's what they say, I'll feel I've accomplished something."
